caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, upright object that is centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of a long, thin vertical pole with a twisted or spiral design running along its length. At the top, the pole branches into two short, U-shaped prongs facing outward, each with a flat inner surface. Attached between the prongs is a short, loose chain. The base of the pole splits into three curved legs that extend outward, each ending in a downward curve, providing stability. The entire drawing is rendered in fine, black lines with no shading or color, and the overall style is minimal and technical. There is a small, handwritten signature at the bottom left corner.
title: Rush and Candle Stand
